surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe labor unrest, liquidity stress, and input cost shocks ahead of Diwali.
what_changed: Surat textile workers launched intensive 'Gaon Chalo' protests and strikes, triggering a migrant worker exodus to UP and Bihar [d6a4b0e6a74b, 73dfcce5d3f4].
Weavers announced a two-day weekly holiday alongside mandatory 15-day yarn payments pre-Diwali [0c72a246c955].
Diamond industry shortened its traditional Diwali vacation for the first time in four years due to improved demand [2b47ff4fa01a].
stress_signals: Steep 66% surge in yarn prices creates shutdown risks and compresses cash flows across upstream weaving units [b62552cc0c7d].
Multiple fraud and default cases reported, including a Rs 15.57 crore textile fraud arrest and a Rs 29.57 lakh grey fabric default [c4997bb35d98, 2718cba9f837].
Intensified embroidery worker agitations over leave disputes and police cases, with 50 workers leaving jobs [af8a29b318b7, 6b7974c7f88e].
improvement_signals: Surat-made fabric-coated balloon airship successfully tested for border surveillance at 21 km altitude [5a6c6ad01d9d].
Diamond boom raises expectations for a rollback of previous worker wage cuts [ff0f473e0921].
MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs build cumulative ₹120 crore textile businesses, marking its 50th year as the cluster moves toward technical textiles [7dc3005e0b28, a1f25f2b05a6].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital limits and debt-service coverage for weaving and embroidery units facing strict 15-day yarn payment terms.
Track labor union negotiations regarding wages, 8-hour workdays, and holiday disputes to assess operational continuity.
Observe inventory buildup and actual capacity utilization during the truncated Diwali vacation period.
